name: 著者のプロフィール紹介
prompt:
Create a 1037 x 549 px Japanese author profile component on a clean white background. Use the high-resolution screenshot crop as the authority for layout and proportions: preserve the large circular author portrait at the upper left, the outlined rounded follow button at the upper right, the bold author line below, muted gray follower statistics beneath it, and two left-aligned biography lines near the bottom. Keep the source's open white layout without a card frame. Use the exact supplied author photo as the portrait, unchanged, at x=0,y=4 with size 197 x 186 px; do not redraw, recolor, crop, or replace the person. The smaller native preview supplies the approved Japanese copy and Lighthouse teal accent color only. Use a clear Japanese sans-serif similar to Meiryo, with a bold author line and regular bio text. Render only the following exact copy:
Button: フォロー
Author: 佐藤 直樹の記事
Followers: 1.2万人の読者・24人をフォロー
Bio line 1: 暮らしの中の発見を綴ります。
Bio line 2: 地域と人をつなぐ活動を続けています。
Keep the button outline and label teal, statistics medium gray, and other text near black. Maintain the original photo and text hierarchy, spacing, and overall content density. No extra words, icons, borders around the whole component, shadows, or decorative elements.
reviewNotes: ImageGen supplied the Japanese text; final was composited onto the exact source screenshot crop after the generated draft altered the portrait. The original avatar region is pixel-identical to the source crop (0 differing pixels); original button geometry is preserved and its outline changed to Lighthouse teal. Pixel-difference audit shows changes only in author, statistics, biography, and button text/outline. Source/candidate comparison visually checked.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: original screenshot crop defining author profile layout and text hierarchy
original author portrait reference; preserve exactly
approved Japanese copy and Lighthouse teal color reference
